label: Patient A (synthetic)
facts: Diagnosis: non-small cell lung cancer, adenocarcinoma (non-squamous), stage IV.
EGFR exon 19 deletion detected on tissue next-generation sequencing at diagnosis.
First-line treatment: osimertinib for 24 months; this is the only systemic treatment received so far.
Radiological disease progression on osimertinib, confirmed by CT two weeks ago.
MET amplification detected in circulating tumour DNA at progression.
No prior chemotherapy, no prior immunotherapy, no prior antibody-drug conjugate.
Two brain metastases treated with stereotactic radiosurgery 8 months ago; stable on MRI, no symptoms, no steroids.
No leptomeningeal disease and no spinal cord compression.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST 1.1 (right lower lobe mass, 32 mm).
Laboratory values: ANC 3.1 x 10^9/L, platelets 210 x 10^9/L, haemoglobin 11.8 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.6 x ULN, ALT 1.1 x ULN, creatinine clearance 78 mL/min.
No history of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
No active hepatitis B, hepatitis C or HIV infection.
QTc 432 ms; no clinically significant cardiac disease.
